Container.Name: cef-tracker
Container.Overview: CEF Tracker — closed-end fund discount-to-NAV surveillance (BUY/WATCH/HOLD/SELL/AVOID signals) over ~367 CEFs, with a CEFConnect/FRED/sponsor data pipeline (APScheduler). Flask/SQLite, single gunicorn worker. Two required persistent volumes: /data (the SQLite DB) and /data/backups (the scheduled SQLite backup the app writes every 3 days at 2am ET) — both on the appdata pool. Set FLASK_SECRET_KEY (required; without it the container starts but stays UNHEALTHY, serving only a 503 that names the missing variable). Google/Microsoft OAuth are optional. FRED key, Anthropic key and ntfy remain managed in-app under Admin → System Settings. SMTP infra creds (host/port/user/password/from) now come from kw-common's fleet-shared configs/alerting.env instead — set the Shared alerting root below to enable outbound email; it is OPTIONAL, and this container runs fine with it unset (email is simply disabled, exactly as an unset smtp_host meant before). See github.com/sdr-ventures/kw-common/blob/main/docs/alerting-setup.md.
Container.Description: CEF Tracker — closed-end fund discount-to-NAV tracker (Flask/SQLite).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite DB directory - the only persistent volume. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where the scheduled SQLite backup lands (system_database_backup, every 3 days at 2am ET, keeps the newest 3 copies and prunes older ones). REQUIRED: the app derives this directory from DB_PATH's own directory below, not from a separate setting — WITHOUT a mount at this exact path the backup writes into the unmounted container filesystem and is destroyed by the next image update, while the job still logs success. Set an absolute path on a POOL; a DIFFERENT pool from the Data mount above is safer (so one pool failure cannot take both the database and its only backup) — Docker mounts this path cleanly underneath the Data mount with no conflict. ⚠️ If you change DB_PATH below to a directory other than /data, the backup job follows it there instead of here — keep this path in sync with DB_PATH's directory, or leave DB_PATH at its default.

Config.Name: FLASK_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Flask session signing key. REQUIRED — if missing or blank the container still starts, but every page returns 503 and Docker reports it UNHEALTHY until you set it. Generate: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

Config.Name: APP_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of THIS deployment; used to build the OAuth redirect URIs, so it must match what is registered with Google/Microsoft. REQUIRED for OAuth sign-in — the image carries no default.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google OAuth client ID (optional; blank disables Google sign-in).

Config.Name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Microsoft OAuth client ID (optional; blank disables Microsoft sign-in).

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite database file, INSIDE the container. Leave as the default unless you know why you are changing it — it must sit under the /data mount above or the database will not survive a restart. Also determines where the scheduled backup writes (its own directory's 'backups' subfolder) — moving this out of /data moves the backup out of the Backups mount above too. Blank is treated as the default.

Config.Name: FLASK_ENV
Config.Description: production (default) or development. Only set development for debugging — it enables debug mode. Blank is treated as production.

Config.Name: TAPE_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of the Tape market-data API this deployment reads from, e.g. https://tape.example.com (no trailing path). Read-only, dual-run only — feeds the NAV parity report, not the app's own signal/history path. OPTIONAL, blank by default; all three TAPE_* values must be set together or the integration stays off.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Tape API client id (X-Client-Id), data-scoped. Provisioned in Tape's client registry. OPTIONAL, blank by default.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Tape API client secret (X-Client-Secret). Provisioned in Tape's client registry. OPTIONAL, blank by default.

Config.Name: Shared alerting root
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. The host directory holding configs/alerting.env - the ONE file every Keystone container reads its SMTP settings from. Mounted READ-ONLY: this container never writes to it. Leave blank to run with outbound email disabled (job-error alert emails and invitation emails will not send; the app itself is unaffected). Full instructions: github.com/sdr-ventures/kw-common/blob/main/docs/alerting-setup.md
